name: Transition Quality
description: Evaluates the mechanical smoothness and explicit connective tissue between sentences and paragraphs. Generative AI models strongly optimize for local coherence, mechanically stitching sentences together using a predictable array of formal transitional markers ('Moreover', 'Furthermore', 'Consequently', 'On the other hand'). This creates an artificially smooth, frictionless reading experience. Human writers, conversely, frequently rely on implicit logical connections, thematic continuity, or narrative momentum, resulting in structurally 'rougher' but contextually natural transitions that omit explicit signposting.
mechanism: The algorithm parses the text to identify the boundaries between sentences and paragraphs. It then scans these junctures for known explicit transitional devices (conjunctions, conjunctive adverbs, specific prepositional phrases). It calculates the ratio of 'explicitly bridged' transitions to 'implicitly continuous' transitions. Furthermore, it evaluates the predictability and variety of the markers used. A text that exhibits near-constant explicit signposting at every logical juncture, utilizing a narrow and highly predictable vocabulary of formal connectors, is flagged as exhibiting artificial transition quality.
useCase: Effective for analyzing academic essays, professional emails, and explanatory content where an overly 'polished' or relentless flow of 'firstly, secondly, finally' structures betrays AI generation.
strengths:
• Highly effective at detecting the distinctive 'formulaic flow' of LLMs, which struggle to trust the reader to infer connections implicitly.
• Works well on medium-length texts where transition patterns can be reliably counted and statistical ratios established.
limitations:
• May produce false positives on texts written by non-native speakers or ESL students who have been explicitly taught to overuse formal transitional markers to ensure clarity.
• Less effective in technical manuals or legal documents where extreme explicit connectivity is structurally required.
parameters:
Analysis: Sentence/Paragraph Boundary Connective Identification
Metric: Ratio of Explicit Transitional Markers to Implied Connections
Output: 0-100 Transition Artificiality Score
accuracy: Moderate to High — 74-83% accuracy. Performs exceptionally well when combined with lexical diversity and syntactic variance metrics to create a full profile of document 'smoothness'.

references.title: Crossley, S. A., et al. (2016). The tool for the automatic analysis of cohesion (TAACO). Behavior Research Methods.
Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. NeurIPS.
